equivalent_ontology_term.description: The other of the MONDO or EFO identifiers for the same trait, when both are present. MONDO is preferred as the edge target when it can be resolved.

lead_chrom.description: Chromosome of the lead variant, without a chr prefix.

lead_pos.description: Position of the lead variant, converted from the Open Targets 1-based coordinate to 0-based.

lead_ref.description: Reference allele of the lead variant.

lead_alt.description: Alternate allele of the lead variant.

phenotype_term.description: Display name of the ontology term used as the edge target. Rows with neither a MONDO nor an EFO identifier are not loaded.

direction.description: Sign of the reported effect of the alternate allele on the trait.

beta.description: Effect size of the alternate allele on the trait.

beta_ci_lower.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval on beta.

beta_ci_upper.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval on beta.

odds_ratio.description: Odds ratio of the alternate allele for a binary trait. 0 when the study reports a beta instead.

oddsr_ci_lower.description: Lower bound of the confidence interval on the odds ratio.

oddsr_ci_upper.description: Upper bound of the confidence interval on the odds ratio.

p_val_exponent.description: Base-10 exponent of the association p-value.

p_value.description: Association p-value, reconstructed from mantissa and exponent.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of the association p-value. Capped at 27000 when the reported p-value is 0.

tagged_variants.description: Variants in LD with the lead, each with its alleles, overall r2, whether it falls in the PICS 95 percent credible set, 1000 Genomes superpopulation proportions, log10 approximate Bayes factor, and posterior probability of causality.

source_url.description: IGVF reference-file page for the Open Targets file this record was read from.

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the IGVF file this record was read from.

version.description: Open Targets Genetics release this record was taken from.

_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the variant key, phenotype ontology term key, study identifier and source name.

study.description: Handle of the studies record this association comes from.

accessible_via.return: name, study, source, source_url, files_filesets, class, method, label, version, lead_chrom, lead_pos, lead_ref, lead_alt, phenotype_term, direction, beta, beta_ci_lower, beta_ci_upper, p_val_mantissa, p_val_exponent, p_value, neg_log10_pvalue, oddsr_ci_lower, oddsr_ci_upper
